source: City of Burton Fire Department incident records (Emergency Networking RMS), calendar year 2025.
notes: Aggregates from the City of Burton Fire Department records system (Emergency Networking RMS). Counts only -- no addresses, names, or individual incidents.
Categories follow the national NFIRS incident-type series. These are fire/rescue incident counts; EMS-coded calls are few in this dataset (medical transport may be recorded separately).
Average response time is dispatch-to-arrival, averaged over incidents with a recorded on-scene time; it includes mutual-aid runs outside the city. Method and figure pending FD confirmation.
2024 is a partial year (Jun-Dec, 437 responses) -- the FD adopted this records system mid-2024. 2025 is the first full calendar year.
Draft -- figures pending Fire Department review. A national (USFA) comparison is a planned addition.
